articles.summary: Fresh Mediterranean flavors have officially arrived in Greenfield, with Madison next on the menu CAVA (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand, opened its doors today at 8833 Sura Lane in Greenfield, WI. CAVA 84 South is a 3,000-square-foot restaurant featuring a bright, welcoming dining room, patio seating, seamless digital order pickup, and delivery designed to meet guests wherever they are in their day. CAVA 84 South Restaurant in Greenfield, WI CAVA brings together rich Mediterranean flavors and wholesome ingredients that nourish without sacrificing taste. With over 17 billion combinations to choose from, Greenfield guests can build meals that deliver on both flavor and health, satisfying their cravings while leaving them feeling great. From a chef-curated bowl or pita, to a build-your-own meal, there’s something for everyone at CAVA. articles.summary: CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand that brings heart, health, and humanity to food, will host a conference call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a business update. A press release with third quarter financial results will be issued at approximately 4:10 PM Eastern Time on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The call will be webcast live from the Company’s website on the investor relations page at investor.cava.com . A recorded webcast will be available on CAVA’s investor relations website shortly after the call and available for up to one year. The latest innovations pair fresh, herby Mediterranean flavors with wholesome ingredients, alongside a seasonal Pomegranate Apple drink. The center of the celebration? CAVA’s new Greek Goddess dressing, a tangy blend of rich Greek yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, herbs, and spices.
